                 “To be successful in life, what you need is Education.”
                                                    -   Jawaharlal Nehru

These simple words summarise the necessity of a proper education, which not only makes a
person literate but also shapes their character. Education is not simply a trend of going to an
institute and gaining a degree; it is an investment for the future marked by improving oneself in
the present.

I heartily welcome you to Khagarijan College. We are delighted to greet the new students, who
will step into our educational institution for the academic session 2026-27. Khagarijan College,
Nagaon, which proclaims a legacy of over fifty years, follows the ideal of Education where
learning is not just a matter of routine but a matter of thorough understanding. Ever since its
inception in 1972, the College has distinguished itself by providing a key service in the
academic, cultural and intellectual fields; dispensing various opportunities to the students of the
deprived section. The College aspires to provide a value-based education and training to its
stakeholders, to fulfil the aspirations and expectations of the learners, empowering them to
achieve their desired goals.

It needs to be mentioned here that the College has been accredited with a ‘B+’ Grade by the
National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) in the year 2023, and efforts are being
continuously made to upgrade this institution by pursuing the 4th Cycle of NAAC accreditation.
The college has also participated in the much-awaited NIRF Rankings of 2025. The horizon of

                                                   4
 professional activities is expanding, and various changes have made a mark in the scenario of
Education in the country. Hence, the college is trying its best to meet these challenges through
the introduction of new courses for the development and empowerment of the student body.
Furthermore, the college has conducted an ICSSR Sponsored National Seminar on “Indian
Knowledge System in Policy Development and Governance” with the aim of pursuing the goal
of research oriented development in the institution, mindset of students and the society at large.

As a global leader in knowledge creation and dissemination, the college has envisioned a unique
trajectory for the 21st century by tapping the transformative power of liberal arts, social sciences
and cutting-edge science and technology education and research. The college offers various
academic programmes for gaining knowledge at the undergraduate level in Humanities, Social
Sciences, Skill-Based Courses in Computer Application and postgraduate level in Assamese.
Along with this, the college also offers provisions for students to take SWAYAM-NPTEL courses
to enhance their portfolio. Besides this, the college has introduced B. Com, BCA and PGDCA
under Gauhati University from the academic session 2020-2021. Regarding infrastructure, the
college is proactive in the present competitive academic world with spacious classrooms and
digital facilities. The Central Library has a rich collection of books, journals, e-journals,
e-resources, as well as computer and Wi-Fi facilities. Infrastructure is also undergoing further
development with the construction of new buildings, sponsored by the RUSA grant.

The college has made considerable growth in the past few years with the introduction of new
courses of study and multiple initiatives. In the 2025-26 session, NCC has been raised in the
college with a total allotted strength of 100 cadets under 8 Assam Bn NCC with the aim of
nurturing the youth of the nation and providing them with more opportunities. The horizon of
professional activities is expanding, and hence, to meet the challenges of the younger generation,
new courses have been initiated for their holistic growth. The Governing Body, faculty members,
office staff, guardians, alumni and well-wishers have given us constant support to enrich this
institution. As an appeal to all the stakeholders for their constant support and suggestions, to
achieve success in the path of all our endeavours; I take this opportunity to assure the aspiring
students, parents and all other stakeholders that the best possible resources of our institution will
be put into action to mould the future of our learners. Education is the right of every child in the
country, and the College will always contribute to the growth of an educated Demographic
Dividend by providing the necessary services to its optimum level.

 PROFILE OF THE COLLEGE
​
Khagarijan College is one of the premier institutions of higher education in Nagaon district,
Assam; a splendid temple of learning in sylvan surroundings. The college was established in
September 1972. The word “Khagarijan” prestigiously displays the original name of Nagaon.
The ‘Putakollongjan’ flows behind the college, branching off from the river Kollong. ‘Jan’ is a
type of rivulet. ‘Khagari’ refers to a type of long reed that grows along the banks of rivers. The
two words ‘Jan’ and ‘Khagari’ joined together give the ancient name of Nagaon, ‘Khagarijan’,
which has been kept alive by this institution. By adopting the name, Khagarijan, the college has
succeeded in rejuvenating the ancient roots and heritage of Nagaon town. The college is
affiliated to Gauhati University and registered under 2(F) and 12(B) of University Grants
Commission Act, 1956.

Since its inception, the college has been a beacon by guarding the cause of education and moral
upliftment of the students. Pursuit of knowledge, has all along been the avowed objective of the
institution and it has justified its existence despite a lot of obstacles standing in its way. Apart
from dissemination of knowledge, the college aims to generate new values; relevant for the new
generation of society.

The College, with a dedicated teaching and administrative staff makes an assiduous effort to
prepare the students for a good career; to face the stark realities of life and help them build up
character and personality to become responsible citizens of the country. It is a matter of pride
that innumerable students have come to the college and left the campus after receiving their
desired degrees, and they have made their marks in different levels of social, political and
academic life.




                                                 6
 Administration
The Governing Body is the decision-making authority of the college, regarding all the major academic
and administrative purposes. Besides this, the college also has multiple cells to shoulder various
administrative responsibilities. The Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) of the college is empowered
to look after the work assigned by the NAAC and overall administration of the college. The Grievance
Redressal Cell supervises the grievances of the students, teachers and non-teaching staff, received through
written complaints. The Parent-Teachers’ Association of the college meets frequently to discuss the
academic growth as well as further development of the college. The Academic Advisory Committee,
formed by incorporating all the HoDs of respective departments, takes the important decisions in
academic matters. The Alumni Association has frequent gatherings to share their experiences with the
present students as well as actively engage in the college activities. The Students’ Association is the sole
representative body of the students which takes various measures to solve their grievances, look after their
welfare and takes an active part in various administrative activities of the college.




Vision​
To spread and promote higher education for the sustainable development of the nation.

​
Mission​
To set a high standard of excellence, in the preservation and creation of knowledge, through
teaching-learning interactions and experimental techniques; and to serve as an effective instrument of
development in the path of education, progress and total awakening. Besides this, the motto is to always
go a little further with a “better every day” spirit.

 College Campus


The Khagarijan College campus is spread around 3.25 acres of land; with a congenial and
eco-friendly ambience for the students. Various infrastructural set-up such as the administrative
building, central library, sports hostel, girls’ hostel, separate building for PG Course and indoor
stadium are encapsulated inside the college campus. The administration takes utmost care to
supervise the campus for security and discipline through CCTV Surveillance.



Collaboration with Other Institutes
The college has a tie up with various institutions like Royal Global University, USTM, ICT
Academy, Tamil Nadu, Ekodus International, S. S. Technology, Net Skill Foundation, Rupahi
College, Nagaon, A.D.P College, Nagaon, Raha College, Raha and two Schools namely Motiram
Bora Girls H.S. School, Nagaon and Sialmari L.P. School, Nagaon.

 Village Adoption
The IQAC and NSS Unit, Khagarijan College has adopted two villages for socio-economic and
educational development named Lalung Gaon, Borkola and Tukulai Bebejia Gaon, Bebejia.




Distance Education Centre


KKHSOU Study Centre

The Krishna Kanta Handiqui State Open University (KKHSOU) Study Centre was established in
the college in 2019. The study Centre offers both Major and Pass course UG programmes in
Assamese, Economics, Education, English, History, Journalism and Mass Communication,
Mathematics, Philosophy, Political Science, Sanskrit and Sociology. MA (Assamese, Economics,
Education, English, History, Philosophy and Political Science), M COM and MSW courses are
available in the centre. Diploma in Mass Communication, Sales and Marketing Management and
Applied Data Analysis programmes have also been introduced in the center.



IDOL Study Centre

Khagarijan College offers dual mode courses under Institute of Open and Distance Learning
(IDOL), Gauhati University. It offers Bachelor of Arts in Assamese, Economics, Education,
English, History and Political Science. Besides, Master of Arts in Assamese; Economics,
Education, English, History, Philosophy and Political Science courses are also available.


                                            10
 NATIONAL SERVICE SCHEME (NSS)
The National Service Scheme is a voluntary organization of college students under the Ministry
of Human Resource Development to inculcate social consciousness and a sense of responsibility
among the youth. The college unit of NSS is vibrant and actively engages in various social
welfare services. At present the Unit is helmed by Mr. Ashraful Alam Choudhury, Associate
Professor, Dept of English as the Programme Officer.




NATIONAL CADET CORPS (NCC)
NCC has been raised in the institution with a total allotted strength of 100 cadets on 11th August
2025 under 8 Assam Bn NCC. This is aimed at the holistic development of youth through
discipline, leadership, and instilling the spirit of patriotism in students. The cadets have
participated in voluntary blood donation drives, cleanliness campaigns, cultural programmes, and
similar activities. At present, the NCC Unit is spearheaded by Maitreyee Dutta, Assistant
Professor, Dept of English, as the Caretaker Officer appointed by NCC.

 Cells and Forums
Career Counselling Cell

The Career Counselling Cell provides career-related information and organizes various programmes on
career opportunities and pursuits for the placement of pass-out students.

Grievance Redressal Cell

The College has a Grievance Redressal Cell, which addresses the grievances of the students inside the
college premise.

Khagarijan College Students’ Association

The Khagarijan College Students’ Association is an elected body of student representatives. They are
entrusted with the responsibility of looking after the welfare of the students. The college authority offers
all kinds of assistance and co-operation to the association to execute the welfare scheme, meant for the
students.

Alumni Association

The College has an active Alumni Association which interacts with the present students. The College
appeals to all the alumni to join the Alumni Association and contact the office bearers to keep themselves
in close touch with their alma mater.

Khagarijan College Research Forum

The Khagarijan College Research Forum, founded in 2013 encourages the faculty members in
research activities. The forum regularly publishes a Half Yearly National Level research journal
named “Pioneer.”

Annual Magazine
The college regularly publishes its annual magazine titled “Amritdhara.” It provides ample
opportunity for the students to explore their creative and intellectual abilities.

 POST-GRADUATE COURSE IN ASSAMESE (SELF-FINANCING) ​

Khagarijan College has a regular PG Course in Assamese under Gauhati University. The PG
Course in Assamese was introduced in the year 2015. The college has a very good departmental
Library for the students. The students are also taken to various places or institutions for
course-oriented field visits. For the better development of the students of PG classes, the
department provides special sessions. Experts from specific fields (included in syllabus from
various Universities of Assam) are invited to deliver lectures in order to benefit the students. At
present, the student intake in PG Class is 25 only. The admission process starts in the month of
July and the course fee per semester is 6000/- only. Admission to PG class is done as per the
guidelines of Gauhati University.


BACHELOR OF COMPUTER APPLICATIONS (SELF-FINANCING)

The college offers Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) in the regular mode under FYUGP
of Gauhati University on a Self-Financing basis. The duration of the course is three years. The
students qualifying HS in Science/ Arts/ Commerce are eligible for admission in the course.
Students completing a Diploma in SSE/ IT from AICTE-recognized institutes are also eligible
for taking admission in the course. The admission process starts immediately after the
declaration of the HS final result.


POST GRADUATE DIPLOMA IN COMPUTER APPLICATION (SELF-FINANCING)

Khagarijan College offers Post Graduate Diploma in Computer Application (PGDCA) under
FYUGP of Gauhati University on a Self-Financing basis. Graduates from any stream are eligible
for admission to the course. The admission process starts immediately after the declaration of
TDC final result. The duration of the course is one year.

CAREER ORIENTED CERTIFICATE COURSE: FUNCTIONAL ENGLISH

Khagarijan College provides a career-oriented course in Functional English. It is a six-month

                                 Facilities and Regulations

College Uniform
The College uniform is compulsory for all students. It is as follows -

FOR BOYS: -​
Black pants (Formal only) and White Shirt with College Logo.

FOR GIRLS: -​
  A)​ Muga or Muga colour Mekhela, Chaddar/Saree with Deep Pink border and White Blouse. ​
  B)​ White Salwar, White Kameez (Knee length) and Deep Pink Dupatta.

Maroon Sweater and Black Shoes/Sandal are common to both boys and girls.

Identity Card
Identity Cards will be issued to each and every bonafide student, which will be valid till the
successful completion of the course. The identity card is valid only after the signature of the
Principal. The students must keep their identity cards with them during the college hours and
have to produce them on demand by the Principal or duly authorized representative of the
Principal. If a student loses his/her Identity card, a duplicate card will be issued after an
application to the Principal.

Examination Rules
All examinations of the college will be conducted by the College Examination Committee. The
students must appear in all the examinations conducted by the college during an academic year;
failing which they will not be allowed to sit in the Final Examination. The examination schedule
is specified in the Academic Calendar of the college.

Attendance Rules
A student shall not be eligible to sit for the end semester examination as a regular candidate if
he/she does not attend a minimum of 75% lectures delivered in each subject separately or 6
credits per week/per paper. Students who fail to attend their classes at a stretch for a certain
period of time on genuine, reasonable and acceptable grounds such as serious disease or accident
or related treatment involving themselves and member(s) of their family, death of near and dear
ones, academic, sports and cultural activities approved by the college etc. must apply in writing
to the Principal, duly forwarded by the concerned Head of the Department, for consideration of
absence in an examination or for a period of time. The application must be supported with
testimonials/documents wherever necessary. Even for such cases, the actual attendance must not
fall short of 50%. The scholarship will be discontinued in case of less than 75% attendance.

 Students’ Code of Conduct
Students must come to the college invariably with prescribed uniforms and identity cards. This
rule is considered as a minimum mandatory requirement in maintaining the discipline of the
college.
   ▪​ Ragging in any form, inside and outside the campus, is strictly prohibited by law. Any
       student found indulging in ragging will be dealt with as per the directives of the Supreme
       Court/High Court.
   ▪​ The college campus is a No Smoking/No Tobacco/ No Drugs/No Alcohol Zone. Students
       found violating these instructions will be dealt with as per rules of the college.
   ▪​ Students should not damage the property of the institution. The cost of any damage will
       be recovered from the student.
   ▪​ Students should not indulge in any anti-social activities or activities causing hindrance to
       the academic and administrative functioning of the college. Those found indulging in
       such activities will be punished and the authority will take disciplinary action against
       them.
   ▪​ During teaching hours, all areas around the classrooms will be observed as silent Zones.
       The authority will deal with students who create a disturbance, as they deem right.
   ▪​ Spitting on walls and grounds, writing and sticking anything on the college walls etc is
       strictly prohibited. Anybody found doing this will be punished.




College Library
Khagarijan College has a Central library with around 17,236 books, including Text Books and
References, along with a reading room that has a capacity of 60 students. It has all kinds of
Textbooks, Reference books, Journals, Newspapers, Magazines and Periodicals etc. The library
remains open from 10 A.M. to 4 P.M. on all working days. Moreover, most of the departments of
the college have separate Departmental Libraries, which provide additional help to students and
teachers.

•​      The library card is not transferable. ​
•​      Each Student is allowed to borrow two books at a time.​
•​      Books are issued to the students for a period of 15 days only. ​
•​      An overdue charge of Rs. 5/ only per day is levied if a book is kept beyond the ​

Hostel Facility and Eligibility
Girls’ Hostel

Khagarijan College has only one Girls’ Hostel of its own inside the college premises. The
college hostel can be considered an integral part of the college. The students are required to
maintain a healthy and congenial atmosphere in the Hostel. The internal management of the
Hostel is looked after by the resident warden. A committee comprising of the Principal, Hostel
Warden and two members from the Teaching Staff looks after the smooth functioning of the
Hostel.

Eligibility:​
•​      Admission to the Hostel is granted only after the college Admission is finalized. ​
•​      Number of Hostel seats is limited and admission is made strictly on the basis of merit. ​
•​      Only outstation students are eligible for admission. ​
•​      Admission is finalized after a personal interview with the candidate’s parents local ​
        guardian.
